items.message: Inertia Laravel 2 changes the client/server protocol and request lifecycle.
items.action: Review shared props, deferred props, polling, and the client adapter while following the Inertia 1 to 2 guide.

items.message: The Inertia client adapter must be upgraded alongside the Laravel adapter.
items.action: Upgrade the JavaScript Inertia adapter and re-run browser navigation and form tests.

items.message: Cashier 15 no longer supports Cashier::ignoreMigrations().
items.action: Remove the call and publish or maintain the Cashier migrations explicitly.

items.message: Cashier 15 renamed the subscription name API to the subscription type API.
items.action: Review newSubscriptionName(), subscription name access, and related billing view references for the type rename.

items.message: Cashier 15 uses invoice terminology and views where older releases used receipt terminology.
items.action: Review published Cashier receipt views and update customizations to the invoice view names.

16.notes: Manual guidance only until the compatibility matrix proposes Cashier 16.

items.message: Cashier 16 contains another major billing API upgrade.
items.action: Review Billable models, invoices, webhooks, and payment method flows against the Cashier 16 guide.

items.message: Cashier 16 may require migration and published-view review after the package major change.
items.action: Compare published Cashier migrations and views before running them in production.

items.message: Passport 12 no longer registers routes through Passport::routes().
items.action: Remove Passport::routes() and verify the OAuth endpoints your application needs are registered by the package.

items.message: Passport password grants are no longer enabled implicitly.
items.action: Call Passport::enablePasswordGrant() deliberately if the application still supports the password grant.

items.message: Passport 12 changes token and scope setup APIs.
items.action: Review token model configuration, scope definitions, and token issuance tests against the Passport 12 guide.

items.message: Passport 13 includes an OAuth model and token compatibility review.
items.action: Check custom token models, claims, scopes, and serialized authorization data against the Passport 13 guide.

items.message: Passport 13 may change the behavior of customized OAuth endpoints.
items.action: Run the complete authorization-code, personal-access-token, and password-grant test matrix.

items.message: Sanctum 4 changes stateful API authentication configuration.
items.action: Review the stateful domain configuration and browser-authenticated API tests after upgrading Sanctum.

items.message: Sanctum 4 may require its current migration set to be published and reviewed.
items.action: Publish Sanctum migrations only when the project does not already contain the current personal-access-token schema.

items.message: Telescope 5 changes how Telescope migrations are managed.
items.action: Review Telescope::ignoreMigrations(), published migrations, and the telescope_entries schema before deployment.

items.message: Telescope 5 has a new package-major migration surface.
items.action: Publish and compare Telescope migrations before running them against a production database.

items.message: Horizon 5 requires a review of supervisor balancing and queue worker configuration.
items.action: Compare config/horizon.php, supervisor environments, and worker restart behavior with the Horizon 5 guide.

6.notes: Manual guidance only until the compatibility matrix proposes Horizon 6.

items.message: Horizon 6 changes worker and monitoring compatibility with the Laravel major.
items.action: Review queue worker options, metrics retention, and deployment restart procedures against the Horizon 6 guide.

items.message: Livewire 2 to 3 is a component and client-runtime migration.
items.action: Review component lifecycle hooks, wire:model behavior, events, and JavaScript integrations using the Livewire 3 guide.

items.message: Livewire component tests need a major-version compatibility pass.
items.action: Run component browser and Livewire test coverage after updating the Livewire client and server packages.

items.message: Jetstream 4 to 5 changes the application scaffolding and supported frontend stack.
items.action: Review published Jetstream views, Fortify configuration, Livewire/Inertia pages, and authentication flows against the Jetstream 5 guide.

items.message: Jetstream published assets are not upgraded by Composer alone.
items.action: Compare published Jetstream resources and re-publish only after preserving intentional customizations.

items.message: Spatie Laravel Permission 6 must be checked against the target Illuminate contracts.
items.action: Review published config, models, and permission cache behavior against the package version supporting this Laravel major.

items.message: Spatie Media Library 11 should be checked against the target Illuminate model and filesystem contracts.
items.action: Run media conversions, URL generation, queued jobs, and custom Media model tests after the Laravel upgrade.

items.message: Spatie Laravel Backup 8 must be checked against the target Illuminate filesystem and console contracts.
items.action: Review backup destinations, notifications, cleanup strategy, and scheduled backup commands against the package guide.

items.message: Spatie Laravel Backup 9 changes backup configuration and filesystem integration.
items.action: Review backup destinations, notifications, cleanup strategy, and scheduled backup commands against the package guide.

items.message: Spatie Laravel Backup 10 changes backup events and integration contracts.
items.action: Run backup, restore, cleanup, and notification tests against the Laravel-compatible package release.

items.message: Spatie Laravel Data 3 should be checked against the target Illuminate serialization contracts.
items.action: Review custom data casts, validation rules, transformers, and serialized API responses against the package guide.

items.message: Spatie Laravel Data 4 changes data object, validation, and transformation behavior.
items.action: Review custom data casts, validation rules, transformers, and serialized API responses against the Data 4 guide.

items.message: Spatie Laravel Ignition 2 should be checked with the target Laravel exception rendering stack.
items.action: Exercise exception pages, custom renderers, and local debugging configuration after the framework upgrade.
